newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa group bids higher than BCH group for Spain's Retevision.
newsitem.headline: Endesa group bids higher than BCH group for Spain's Retevision.

text.p: The offer for Retevision from the consortium headed by Spain's Endesa exceeded by more than 32 billion pesetas ($221.4 million) the offer presented by the BCH consortium, secretary general of Retevision Jose Manuel Garcia-Mon said on Tuesday.
Retevision is to become Spain's second basic telephone operator. ($ = 144.5 Spanish Pesetas)
